Add CCSR categories to a NIS query

Source: R/ccsr-query.R
nis_add_ccsr.Rd

Add Clinical Classifications Software Refined categories to a DuckDB query.

Usage

nis_add_ccsr(
  .data,
  categories = NULL,
  type = c("dx", "pr"),
  position = c("any", "principal", "default"),
  version = NULL,
  name = "ccsr"
)

Arguments

.data

Lazy DuckDB query with YEAR and canonical I10_DX<n> or I10_PR<n> slots. When present, DQTR identifies Q4 2015 and DXVER or PRVER must be 10 or missing for ICD-10 records.

categories

Optional character vector of CCSR category codes, such as "CIR019", to keep. The default returns all assigned categories.

type

"dx" for diagnoses or "pr" for procedures.

position

"any" checks all slots, "principal" checks slot 1, and "default" returns the inpatient principal diagnosis default.

version

Optional bundled version, such as "2025.1", to use across years.

name

Name of the new column.

Value

A lazy DuckDB query with one additional column.

Details

Matches full ICD-10 codes. The any-position and principal modes return distinct categories as a list. The diagnosis default mode returns one inpatient principal diagnosis category.

The bundled 2025.1 mappings cover Q4 2015 and calendar years 2016 through 2024. Pin a version to use the same categories across years. Out-of-coverage discharges receive missing results. Within coverage, unmatched discharges receive an empty list or a missing default category.

See also

Define and save a cohort, Define and save a cohort, nis_ccsr_codes(), AHRQ HCUP CCSR.

Examples

nis <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019:2020))
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/Rtmpu4SATS/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.
#> • Secrets are lost.
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = TRUE) (or create ~/.duckdb) to keep them (suitable for most users).
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to accept the temporary directory (and silence this message).
#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.

#> ℹ /tmp/Rtmpu4SATS/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.

nis |>
  nis_add_ccsr(position = "default") |>
  dplyr::count(ccsr) |>
  dplyr::collect()
#> # A tibble: 2 × 2
